title: Conditions, Boolean Logic, and Boundaries
summary: Write clear decisions with comparisons, short-circuit operators, if/else, switch, scoped declarations, and boundary tests.
learningObjectives: Explain and apply Conditions, Boolean Logic, and Boundaries
Compile and test behavior with observable evidence
prerequisiteConcepts: Ability to create and save a text file

sections.heading: Core model
sections.content: Conditions use `bool`, and `&&` plus `||` short-circuit. Place validity checks before dependent expressions such as division or indexing. Use `if` chains for ranges and `switch` for discrete integral or enumeration values. Every case should terminate intentionally with `break`, `return`, or a documented fallthrough. Keep variables in the smallest useful scope. Do not confuse assignment with equality, and enable warnings that identify suspicious conditions. Test immediately below, at, and above each threshold.
